lines.gurmukhi: ਕੋਈ ਜਿ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਲੋਭੀਆ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਸੁਣੀ ਕਹਿਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: koee j moorakh lobheeaa mool na sunee kahiaa ||2||
lines.translation: But he is foolish and greedy, and he never listens to what he is told. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕਸੁ ਦੁਹੁ ਚਹੁ ਕਿਆ ਗਣੀ ਸਭ ਇਕਤੁ ਸਾਦਿ ਮੁਠੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikas duhu chahu kiaa ganee sabh ikat saad muthee ||
lines.translation: Why bother to count one, two, three, four? The whole world is defrauded by the same enticements.

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਕੁ ਅਧੁ ਨਾਇ ਰਸੀਅੜਾ ਕਾ ਵਿਰਲੀ ਜਾਇ ਵੁਠੀ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: ik adh naai raseeaRaa kaa viralee jaai vuthee ||3||
lines.translation: Hardly anyone loves the Lord's Name; how rare is that place which is in bloom. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਸਚੇ ਦਰਿ ਸੋਹਦੇ ਅਨਦ ਕਰਹਿ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat sache dar sohade anad karahi din raat ||
lines.translation: The devotees look beautiful in the True Court; night and day, they are happy.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੈ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਤ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੬੯॥
lines.transliteration: ra(n)g rate paramesarai jan naanak tin bal jaat ||4||1||169||
lines.translation: They are imbued with the Love of the Transcendent Lord; servant Nanak is a sacrifice to them. ||4||1||169||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਮਾਂਝ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee mahalaa 5 maa(n)jh ||
lines.translation: Gauree, Fifth Mehl, Maajh:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਜੀ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh bha(n)jan teraa naam jee dukh bha(n)jan teraa naam ||
lines.translation: The Destroyer of sorrow is Your Name, Lord; the Destroyer of sorrow is Your Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: aath pahar aaraadheeai pooran satigur giaan ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Twenty-four hours a day, dwell upon the wisdom of the Perfect True Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਤੁ ਘਟਿ ਵਸੈ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਥਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jit ghat vasai paarabraham soee suhaavaa thaau ||
lines.translation: That heart, in which the Supreme Lord God abides, is the most beautiful place.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਮ ਕੰਕਰੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jam ka(n)kar neR na aavaee rasanaa har gun gaau ||1||
lines.translation: The Messenger of Death does not even approach those who chant the Glorious Praises of the Lord with the tongue. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇਵਾ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਣੀਆ ਨਾ ਜਾਪੈ ਆਰਾਧਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sevaa surat na jaaneeaa naa jaapai aaraadh ||
lines.translation: I have not understood the wisdom of serving Him, nor have I worshipped Him in meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਟ ਤੇਰੀ ਜਗਜੀਵਨਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: ot teree jagajeevanaa mere thaakur agam agaadh ||2||
lines.translation: You are my Support, O Life of the World; O my Lord and Master, Inaccessible and Incomprehensible. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਸਾਈਆ ਨਠੇ ਸੋਗ ਸੰਤਾਪ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhae kripaal gusaaeeaa nathe sog sa(n)taap ||
lines.translation: When the Lord of the Universe became merciful, sorrow and suffering departed.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਤੀ ਵਾਉ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਰਖੇ ਆਪਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tatee vaau na lagaee satigur rakhe aap ||3||
lines.translation: The hot winds do not even touch those who are protected by the True Guru. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਦਯੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur naaraain day gur gur sachaa sirajanahaar ||
lines.translation: The Guru is the All-pervading Lord, the Guru is the Merciful Master; the Guru is the True Creator Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਿ ਤੁਠੈ ਸਭ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੭੦॥
lines.transliteration: gur tuthai sabh kichh paaiaa jan naanak sad balihaar ||4||2||170||
lines.translation: When the Guru was totally satisfied, I obtained everything. Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||4||2||170||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee maajh mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
lines.transliteration: har raam raam raam raamaa ||
lines.translation: The Lord, the Lord, Raam, Raam, Raam:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਪਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jap pooran hoe kaamaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: meditating on Him, all affairs are resolved. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਮ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਜਪੇਦਿਆ ਹੋਆ ਮੁਖੁ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: raam gobi(n)d japediaa hoaa mukh pavitr ||
lines.translation: Chanting the Name of the Lord of the Universe, one's mouth is sanctified.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਜਿਸ ਤੇ ਸੋਈ ਭਾਈ ਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har jas suneeai jis te soee bhaaee mitr ||1||
lines.translation: One who recites to me the Praises of the Lord is my friend and brother. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਸਭਿ ਫਲਾ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh padaarath sabh phalaa sarab gunaa jis maahi ||
lines.translation: All treasures, all rewards and all virtues are in the Lord of the Universe.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਉ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਮਨਹੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਐ ਜਿਸੁ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਦੁਖ ਜਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: kiu gobi(n)d manahu visaareeai jis simarat dukh jaahi ||2||
lines.translation: Why forget Him from your mind? Remembering Him in meditation, pain departs. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਲੜਿ ਲਗਿਐ ਜੀਵੀਐ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਪਈਐ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jis laR lagiai jeeveeai bhavajal paeeai paar ||
lines.translation: Grasping the hem of His robe, we live, and cross over the terrifying world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: mil saadhoo sa(n)g udhaar hoi mukh oojal darabaar ||3||
lines.translation: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, one is saved, and one's face becomes radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਨ ਰੂਪ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਜਸੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jeevan roop gopaal jas sa(n)t janaa kee raas ||
lines.translation: The Praise of the Sustainer of the Universe is the essence of life, and the wealth of His Saints.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਉਬਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਾਬਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੭੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak ubare naam jap dar sachai saabaas ||4||3||171||
lines.translation: Nanak is saved, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord; in the True Court, he is cheered and applauded. ||4||3||171||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਮਾਝ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee maajh mahalaa 5 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Maajh, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੀਠੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ਜਿੰਦੂ ਤੂੰ ਮੀਠੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: meethe har gun gaau ji(n)doo too(n) meethe har gun gaau ||
lines.translation: Sing the Sweet Praises of the Lord, O my soul, sing the Sweet Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਿਥਾਵੇ ਥਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: sache setee ratiaa miliaa nithaave thaau ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Attuned to the True One, even the homeless find a home. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਹੋਰਿ ਸਾਦ ਸਭਿ ਫਿਕਿਆ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਫਿਕਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hor saad sabh phikiaa tan man phikaa hoi ||
lines.translation: All other tastes are bland and insipid; through them, the body and mind are rendered insipid as well.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਫਿਟੁ ਸੁ ਜੀਵਣੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: vin paramesar jo kare phit s jeevan soi ||1||
lines.translation: Without the Transcendent Lord, what can anyone do? Cursed is his life, and cursed his reputation. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਚਲੁ ਗਹਿ ਕੈ ਸਾਧ ਕਾ ਤਰਣਾ ਇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)chal gahi kai saadh kaa taranaa ihu sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: Grasping the hem of the robe of the Holy Saint, we cross over the world-ocean.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਆਰਾਧੀਐ ਉਧਰੈ ਸਭ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: paarabraham aaraadheeai udharai sabh paravaar ||2||
lines.translation: Worship and adore the Supreme Lord God, and all your family will be saved as well. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾਜਨੁ ਬੰਧੁ ਸੁਮਿਤ੍ਰੁ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਦੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: saajan ba(n)dh sumitr so har naam hiradai dei ||
lines.translation: He is a companion, a relative, and a good friend of mine, who implants the Lord's Name within my heart.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਗਣ ਸਭਿ ਮਿਟਾਇ ਕੈ ਪਰਉਪਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: augan sabh mitaai kai paraupakaar karei ||3||
lines.translation: He washes off all my demerits, and is so generous to me. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਲੁ ਖਜਾਨਾ ਥੇਹੁ ਘਰੁ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
lines.transliteration: maal khajaanaa thehu ghar har ke charan nidhaan ||
lines.translation: Wealth, treasures, and household are all just ruins; the Lord's Feet are the only treasure.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਾਚਕੁ ਦਰਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਧਨੋ ਮੰਗੈ ਦਾਨੁ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੭੨॥
lines.transliteration: naanak jaachak dar terai prabh tudhano ma(n)gai daan ||4||4||172||
lines.translation: Nanak is a beggar standing at Your Door, God; he begs for Your charity. ||4||4||172||
